Stat Blocks.raw_text:
**BLACK FEATHERED DRAGON**
*Gargantuan dragon (chromatic), chaotic evil*
**AC** 22 (natural armor)
**HP** 409 (21d20 + 189)
**Speed** 60 ft., fly 120 ft., swim 60 ft.
**STR** 27 (+8) | **DEX** 16 (+3) | **CON** 28 (+9) | **INT** 19 (+4) | **WIS** 17 (+3) | **CHA** 22 (+6)
**Saving Throws** Dex +10, Con +16, Wis +10, Cha +13
**Skills** Intimidation +13, Perception +17, Stealth +10
**Immunities** acid
**Condition Immunities** charmed, frightened
**Senses** truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 27
**Languages** all, telepathy 240 ft.
**CR** 24 (62,000 XP) **Proficiency Bonus** +7

**TRAITS**
*Eidolic*

**LEGENDARY REACTIONS** (4 uses)
TBA

***Uncanny Corrosion.*** Acid damage from the dragon ignores resistances, and immunity to acid damage only reduces the damage to half instead. This does not apply to damage the dragon might deal to itself.

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** The dragon makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.

***Bite.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 18 (3d12) acid damage.

***Claw.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it is restrained and grappled (escape DC 20). While grappling a creature this way it cannot make Claw attacks except one each turn against the grappled creature.

***Tail.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (2d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

***Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6).*** The dragon uses one of its breath weapon options (Acid River or Sphere of Corrosion).
• ***Acid River.*** The dragon breathes a 300-foot-cone of acid. All creatures within range must succeed a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or take 24 (4d12) acid damage. Any surface this cone touches becomes coated in acid that erodes it for the next hour, during which time it is difficult terrain. Any creature that ends their turn within this area must make a DC 24 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (2d10) acid damage.
• ***Sphere of Corrosion.*** The dragon fires a compressed sphere of acid at a point it can see within 300 feet, which erupts in a 60-foot-radius sphere of acidic ichor. Each creature in that area must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 78 (12d12) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

**BONUS ACTIONS**
***Change Shape.*** The dragon transforms into any creature that is Medium, Small or Tiny, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size), though if it is Tiny it cannot use its Multiattack. This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

**REACTIONS**
***Acidic Blood.*** In response to being targeted by an attack, the dragon produces an excess of acid that is pumped through their veins. Any creature that hits them with a melee attack from within 5 feet until the end of the turn takes 10 (2d10) acid damage and has disadvantage on the next attack they make until the end of the turn.

***Beyond the Web (Recharge 5-6).*** When one or more creatures within 120 feet of the feathered dragon is targeted by the same magical effect or spell (except itself), the feathered dragon may grant them a +5 bonus on the first save they make against it.

**LEGENDARY ACTIONS (3 ACTIONS)**
***Attack.*** The dragon makes one Claw or Tail attack.
***Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions).*** The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (1d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage and 6 (1d12) acid damage and are knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.
***Choking Miasma (Costs 3 Actions).*** An acidic mist sweeps across a 30-foot-cube centered on a point the dragon can see within 120 feet. Each creature in range must succeed a DC 24 Constitution saving throw or be blinded and unable to speak until the end of their next turn.
